source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

lines.en: Hello. Are you ready to improve your English?
lines.zh: 哈囉，準備好提升你的英文了嗎？

lines.en: Well, today you are inside of my garbage can and I am going to make you a video of comprehensible input. What is comprehensible input?
lines.zh: 今天你在我的垃圾桶裡面，我要為你做一支「可理解輸入」的影片。什麼是可理解輸入？

lines.en: Comprehensible input is when a native speaker like me speaks in a way that you can understand.
lines.zh: 可理解輸入就是像我這樣的母語人士，用你聽得懂的方式說話。

lines.en: I'm going to make a video showing you all of the chores. the chores that people do at their homes all around the world.
lines.zh: 我要做一支影片，給你看所有的家事，也就是世界各地的人在家裡做的那些事。

lines.en: But first, I have to take out the trash. Let's go.
lines.zh: 但首先，我得先去倒垃圾。走吧。

lines.en: Hey guys, it is your English speaking friend Kyle and today we've got a video full of important vocabulary.
lines.zh: 嘿大家，我是你們說英文的朋友 Kyle，今天這支影片充滿重要的單字。

lines.en: Today I'm going to make you guys a video showing you something that we all have to do, but I think most of us don't really like doing.
lines.zh: 今天我要做一支影片，讓大家看一件我們都得做、但我想大部分人都不太喜歡做的事。

lines.en: Chores. What are chores?
lines.zh: 家事。什麼是家事？

lines.en: Chores are the things that you do around your house to keep your house clean, to make sure that you have a nice place to live.
lines.zh: 家事就是你在家裡做的那些事，讓家裡保持乾淨，確保你有個舒服的地方住。

lines.en: But for most of us, it's not really a fun thing.
lines.zh: 但對我們大多數人來說，那不是什麼好玩的事。

lines.en: People don't usually say, "Ooh, I get to do chores today."
lines.zh: 通常沒有人會說：「喔～今天可以做家事耶。」

lines.en: No, it's more like ah I have to do chores today.
lines.zh: 不，比較像是：啊，今天得做家事了。

lines.en: But it is an important part of daily life.
lines.zh: 但它是日常生活很重要的一部分。

lines.en: So today I'm going to be showing you all the chores that we do around the house, how to say them in English.
lines.zh: 所以今天我要示範我們在家裡做的所有家事，還有它們的英文怎麼說。

lines.en: And I think that the camera wife is really going to love this video because she's going to get to see me doing chores. All right.
lines.zh: 我想鏡頭老婆會非常喜歡這支影片，因為她可以看到我做家事。好。

lines.en: This is a vacuum cleaner.
lines.zh: 這是吸塵器。

lines.en: This is a vacuum cleaner, guys.
lines.zh: 大家，這是吸塵器。

lines.en: And you use a vacuum cleaner to vacuum. Okay?
lines.zh: 你用吸塵器來吸地板，懂嗎？

lines.en: And what the vacuum cleaner does is it sucks.
lines.zh: 吸塵器做的事就是「吸」。

lines.en: It sucks little pieces of dirt, animal hair, any little thing that's on your floor.
lines.zh: 它會把小灰塵、動物毛髮、任何在地板上的小東西吸起來。

lines.en: The vacuum cleaner sucks those things up.
lines.zh: 吸塵器會把那些東西吸起來。

lines.en: It sucks them into here and then you can take this off and throw it away and get it off of your floor.
lines.zh: 吸到這裡面，然後你可以把這個拆下來倒掉，讓那些東西離開你的地板。

lines.en: So, the vacuum cleaner is for cleaning the floor.
lines.zh: 所以吸塵器是用來清潔地板的。

lines.en: Now, there's another thing that is for getting little things up off of your floor for cleaning your floor as well. That is a broom.
lines.zh: 還有另一樣東西，也是用來把地上的小東西清起來、清潔地板的，那就是掃把。

lines.en: This is called a broom.
lines.zh: 這個叫做掃把。

lines.en: And this is called a dustpan.
lines.zh: 這個叫做畚箕。

lines.en: And you use a broom to sweep to sweep.
lines.zh: 你用掃把來掃地。

lines.en: So, if they kind of do the same thing, when do you use a broom and when do you use a vacuum cleaner? Good question.
lines.zh: 那如果它們做的事差不多，什麼時候用掃把、什麼時候用吸塵器呢？好問題。

lines.en: So, you can use a vacuum cleaner on a wood floor like this, a floor made out of wood, or on a rug or a carpet.
lines.zh: 吸塵器可以用在像這樣的木頭地板上，也就是木頭做的地板，也可以用在小地毯或整片地毯上。

lines.en: This is a rug. The difference between a rug and a carpet is that a rug only covers part of the floor.
lines.zh: 這是小地毯。rug 和 carpet 的差別在於，rug 只蓋住地板的一部分。

lines.en: You put a rug down on the floor.
lines.zh: rug 是你鋪在地板上的。

lines.en: A carpet covers the whole floor in the house or the room.
lines.zh: carpet 則是鋪滿整間房子或整個房間的地板。

lines.en: So, when you're trying to clean up the wood floor, you can use the broom and the dust pan and sweep it up to sweep to sweep up the dirt or you can use the vacuum cleaner to vacuum up the dirt.
lines.zh: 所以當你要清潔木頭地板時，可以用掃把和畚箕把灰塵掃起來，也可以用吸塵器把灰塵吸起來。

lines.en: But you cannot use a broom to sweep up a carpet. It doesn't work.
lines.zh: 但你不能用掃把掃地毯，沒有用的。

lines.en: So, for that reason, you can use the vacuum cleaner. camera wife's going to love this.
lines.zh: 所以這種情況就可以用吸塵器。鏡頭老婆一定會很愛這段。

lines.en: Right now, I am vacuuming our rug and vacuuming our rug. Okay.
lines.zh: 現在我正在吸我們的地毯。好。

lines.en: Now, another thing that is very common when cleaning floors is to mop.
lines.zh: 另一件清潔地板時很常做的事是拖地。

lines.en: This is called a mop, and you use it to mop.
lines.zh: 這個叫做拖把，你用它來拖地。

lines.en: The verb is to mop the floor.
lines.zh: 動詞是 to mop the floor（拖地）。

lines.en: But camera wife does a very good job with that. She already did it.
lines.zh: 不過鏡頭老婆拖得很好，她已經拖過了。

lines.en: So, I'm not going to make a mess with a bunch of water and a mop just to show you guys.
lines.zh: 所以我不會為了示範給你們看，就用一堆水和拖把把地板弄得一團亂。

lines.en: But just know that's a mop and you do not use a mop on rugs or carpets. Okay?
lines.zh: 但要知道那就是拖把，而且拖把不能用在小地毯或地毯上，好嗎？

lines.en: Mm- never mop your carpet. All right, guys.
lines.zh: 嗯，千萬不要拖你的地毯。好，大家。

lines.en: If you have seen really any of my videos, you know, you know that I love I love to cook.
lines.zh: 如果你看過我任何一支影片，就知道我很愛煮飯。

lines.en: But the problem with cooking is that it makes one chore in your house a lot more difficult. doing the dishes, cleaning the dishes, washing the dishes.
lines.zh: 但煮飯的問題是，它會讓家裡的一件家事變得麻煩很多：洗碗。

lines.en: There's a lot of ways to say it, but when we're talking about cleaning the dishes, the pots, the bowls, the glasses, spoons, we usually just say doing the dishes.
lines.zh: 說法有很多種，但講到洗碗盤、鍋子、碗、杯子、湯匙時，我們通常就說 doing the dishes。

lines.en: Okay? You could say, "I have to wash the dishes."
lines.zh: 好嗎？你也可以說：「我得洗碗了。」

lines.en: But in my house, usually we say, "Oh man, now I have to do the dishes."
lines.zh: 但在我們家，通常會說：「唉，現在又得洗碗了。」

lines.en: All that means is that you're going to clean all of the things that you use to cook and to eat.
lines.zh: 意思就是你要把煮飯和吃飯用到的所有東西都洗乾淨。

lines.en: One tip, one way to use your chore time better is to listen, listen to some English or anything you want to learn about while you're doing your chores.
lines.zh: 一個小技巧，讓做家事的時間更有效率：做家事時聽點英文，或任何你想學的東西。

lines.en: That's something I always do whenever I'm doing chores.
lines.zh: 我做家事時一直都這樣做。

lines.en: Many times I've washed the dishes listening to a podcast in Spanish or French or about anything that I was trying to learn.
lines.zh: 我有很多次一邊洗碗、一邊聽西班牙文或法文的 podcast，或任何我在學的東西。

lines.en: So guys, use your time wisely.
lines.zh: 所以大家，要聰明利用時間。

lines.en: You'll be surprised how much that little bit of extra time can really make a difference.
lines.zh: 你會很驚訝，那一點點額外的時間真的能帶來很大的差別。

lines.en: All right guys, now to do dishes, you need soap, water, and some people use sponges. Some people use washcloths.
lines.zh: 好，大家，洗碗需要肥皂、水，有些人用海綿，有些人用抹布。

lines.en: We use this brush usually and whenever the the brush part gets dirty, you can take it off and put a new one on.
lines.zh: 我們通常用這支刷子，刷頭髒了就可以拆下來換一個新的。

lines.en: So, we put a little bit of soap on the brush and then you brush the soap on, clean off any food that's on there.
lines.zh: 我們在刷子上擠一點洗碗精，把它刷上去，把上面的食物殘渣清掉。

lines.en: Then you rinse it with water.
lines.zh: 然後用水沖乾淨。

lines.en: Then you got a clean plate.
lines.zh: 這樣你就有一個乾淨的盤子了。

lines.en: Now, some people wash their dishes and then dry them off with a towel very quickly.
lines.zh: 有些人洗完碗會很快用毛巾擦乾。

lines.en: But we have this this little rack over here and you put the dishes standing up like this and the water slowly comes off of it and they dry just being out in the open in the air.
lines.zh: 但我們這邊有這個小架子，把碗盤像這樣立起來，水會慢慢流掉，碗盤放在空氣中就會自然乾。

lines.en: So that's pretty cool. That's doing the dishes, guys.
lines.zh: 這很方便。這就是洗碗，大家。

lines.en: And unfortunately in this house because we cook so much, we have a lot of dishes.
lines.zh: 可惜在這個家，因為我們很常煮飯，所以碗盤很多。

lines.en: But I wouldn't change that for the world.
lines.zh: 但給我全世界我也不換。

lines.en: You guys saw the fast food video I made on that day. There were no dishes.
lines.zh: 你們有看我拍的那支速食影片，那天完全沒有碗要洗。

lines.en: But I did not feel good.
lines.zh: 但我身體不太舒服。

lines.en: So, I'll keep doing the dishes.
lines.zh: 所以我還是繼續洗碗吧。

lines.en: Well, to be honest, camera wife does more dishes than I do. I'm lucky. All right, guys.
lines.zh: 老實說，鏡頭老婆洗的碗比我多，我很幸運。好，大家。

lines.en: Here I am in camera wife and my bedroom. Okay.
lines.zh: 我現在在鏡頭老婆和我的臥室，好。

lines.en: And as you could see, the bed is a mess. Okay.
lines.zh: 你們可以看到，床亂成一團。好。

lines.en: If camera wife comes home and sees that I left the bed like this, she's going to be mad.
lines.zh: 如果鏡頭老婆回家看到我把床弄成這樣，她會生氣。

lines.en: She's going to be so mad at me. Just kidding, guys.
lines.zh: 她會非常生我的氣。開玩笑的啦，大家。

lines.en: But if your bed looks like this, there's a chore that you can do to make your bed look nice.
lines.zh: 但如果你的床長這樣，有一件家事可以讓你的床看起來整齊。

lines.en: Do you know what that chore is called? Making your bed.
lines.zh: 你知道那件家事叫什麼嗎？鋪床。

lines.en: And this is how you make your bed.
lines.zh: 這就是鋪床的方法。

lines.en: You put your pillows, your pillows up here where your head goes.
lines.zh: 你把枕頭放在上面這裡，放頭的地方。

lines.en: This is called the comforter.
lines.zh: 這個叫做棉被。

lines.en: This part is called a sheet.
lines.zh: 這個部分叫做床單。

lines.en: And camera wife likes it when the sheet is nice and tight like this.
lines.zh: 鏡頭老婆喜歡床單像這樣拉得平平整整、緊緊的。

lines.en: She's going to be happy when she sees this video that I'm doing this cuz a lot of times I don't do it.
lines.zh: 她看到這支影片會很開心，因為我很多時候都沒做這件事。

lines.en: And then you take the comforter, put it nice across the bed. All right, guys.
lines.zh: 然後你拿起棉被，把它平鋪在床上。好，大家。

lines.en: There's probably ways to make your bed a lot nicer.
lines.zh: 鋪床應該還有更講究的方法。

lines.en: Some people will do something like this.
lines.zh: 有些人會這樣做。

lines.en: I don't really care that much about it.
lines.zh: 我其實不太在意。

lines.en: I think it looks okay like this.
lines.zh: 我覺得這樣就還可以。

lines.en: And I just am happy to come home after a hard day of work, have a nice clean bed to lay down in and sleep in.
lines.zh: 辛苦工作一整天回到家，有一張乾淨整齊的床可以躺、可以睡，我就很開心了。

lines.en: That's a made bed. Okay, making your bed.
lines.zh: 這就是鋪好的床。好，這就是鋪床。

lines.en: So, you probably want to tell your children sometimes, hey, go clean your room and make your bed. Make your bed.
lines.zh: 所以你可能有時候會想跟孩子說：嘿，去整理你的房間、鋪好你的床。鋪床。

lines.en: Guys, something interesting I want to say.
lines.zh: 大家，我想說一件有趣的事。

lines.en: There's a book about this that I saw before.
lines.zh: 我之前看過一本關於這個的書。

lines.en: It's something about making your bed is the title of the book.
lines.zh: 書名好像跟鋪床有關。

lines.en: The importance of making your bed or something like that.
lines.zh: 《鋪床的重要性》之類的。

lines.en: But the idea is that when you make your bed, right when you get up, when you wake up in the morning, if you start your day by making your bed, your day will be much more organized, much more ordered.
lines.zh: 但它的概念是，一起床、早上醒來就鋪床，如果你用鋪床來開始你的一天，你的一天會更有條理、更有秩序。

lines.en: And I don't know, I don't make my bed every day, but I have a wonderful partner who does help me.
lines.zh: 而且我不知道，我不是每天都鋪床，但我有一個很棒的另一半會幫我。

lines.en: So, that's the cool thing about being married, guys.
lines.zh: 所以大家，這就是結婚很棒的地方。

lines.en: When you have your weaknesses, your partner can help you, and you can help them with their weaknesses to be a strong team together.
lines.zh: 當你有弱點時，另一半可以幫你，你也可以幫他們彌補弱點，一起成為堅強的團隊。

lines.en: All right, now time to do some clothes.
lines.zh: 好，現在來處理衣服。

lines.en: Do you guys know what this thing is called?
lines.zh: 你們知道這個東西叫什麼嗎？

lines.en: I have no idea how to say this in any other language.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道其他語言怎麼說。

lines.en: So, I'm sure that many of you do not know how to say this in English.
lines.zh: 所以我相信你們很多人也不知道英文怎麼說。

lines.en: This is called a clothes hamper, but we usually just call it a hamper.
lines.zh: 這個叫做 clothes hamper（髒衣籃），但我們通常只叫它 hamper。

lines.en: And you put your dirty clothes inside.
lines.zh: 你把髒衣服放進去。

lines.en: Okay? put your dirty clothes inside here so that you can carry them to your washing machine or wherever you clean your clothes.
lines.zh: 好嗎？把髒衣服放進這裡，這樣就可以提到洗衣機那裡，或任何你洗衣服的地方。

lines.en: So, let's go check that out.
lines.zh: 我們去看看吧。

lines.en: I'll show you all the vocabulary you need to know in order to clean your clothes. Chores. Chores. Chores. All right, guys.
lines.zh: 我會教你洗衣服需要知道的所有單字。家事、家事、家事。好，大家。

lines.en: We are down here in my basement.
lines.zh: 我們現在在地下室。

lines.en: The basement is the part of some houses that's underneath the main floor.
lines.zh: 地下室是有些房子在主樓層下面的部分。

lines.en: Okay, the main floor is where we were.
lines.zh: 好，主樓層就是我們剛剛在的地方。

lines.en: We were up there where I showed you the vacuum where I was sweeping the floor.
lines.zh: 我們剛剛在上面，我示範吸塵器、掃地的地方。

lines.en: That's above me right now.
lines.zh: 那裡現在在我上面。

lines.en: Right now we are down in the basement. Okay.
lines.zh: 現在我們在下面的地下室。好。

lines.en: And we are down in the basement because that's where the washing machine and the dryer are in this house. So guys, washing machine.
lines.zh: 我們在地下室，是因為這間房子的洗衣機和烘衣機在這裡。所以大家，洗衣機。

lines.en: This is the washing machine. You open this. You open the lid.
lines.zh: 這是洗衣機。你把這個打開，打開蓋子。

lines.en: You put what do they call this? Detergent.
lines.zh: 你放入……那個叫什麼？洗衣精。

lines.en: So you open the lid.
lines.zh: 所以你打開蓋子。

lines.en: You put some soap or some detergent in, close the lid, turn it on, water starts going in there, and then it starts spinning around and washing your clothes.
lines.zh: 放一些肥皂或洗衣精進去，蓋上蓋子、打開電源，水就會開始流進去，然後它開始轉動、洗你的衣服。

lines.en: Now, it's really cool that we have washing machines.
lines.zh: 我們有洗衣機真的很棒。

lines.en: If we didn't have washing machines, it would be much more difficult to wash your clothes.
lines.zh: 如果沒有洗衣機，洗衣服會困難很多。

lines.en: You'd have to scrub and scrub and scrub in a a sink in your bathtub.
lines.zh: 你得在水槽或浴缸裡一直刷、一直刷、一直刷。

lines.en: I've heard of people doing their clothes in bathtubs and one time I had to do some laundry in a bathtub because the washing machine broke at my old house.
lines.zh: 我聽說過有人在浴缸裡洗衣服，我自己也有一次得在浴缸裡洗衣服，因為我舊家的洗衣機壞了。

lines.en: So, I know a lot of people still probably don't have these around the world, but I'm happy that we have one because I know doing laundry without having a washing machine, it's not very fun.
lines.zh: 所以我知道世界上應該還有很多人沒有洗衣機，但我很開心我們有一台，因為我知道沒有洗衣機洗衣服一點都不好玩。

lines.en: So, I'm using a word maybe you haven't heard before. Doing laundry. To do the laundry.
lines.zh: 我用了一個你可能沒聽過的詞：doing laundry，也就是 to do the laundry（洗衣服）。

lines.en: Laundry is another word for your clothes. Cleaning your clothes. Doing the laundry.
lines.zh: laundry 是衣服的另一種說法，指要洗的衣服。洗衣服就是 doing the laundry。

lines.en: Doing the laundry is washing your clothes.
lines.zh: doing the laundry 就是洗你的衣服。

lines.en: And then over here we have the dryer. Okay.
lines.zh: 然後這邊是烘衣機。好。

lines.en: So, the washing machine washes your clothes. It cleans them.
lines.zh: 洗衣機會洗你的衣服，把它們洗乾淨。

lines.en: And then you open this.
lines.zh: 然後你把這個打開。

lines.en: This is called the dryer.
lines.zh: 這個叫做烘衣機。

lines.en: You throw the clothes in there. Turn it on. Turn the button on.
lines.zh: 你把衣服丟進去，打開它，按下按鈕。

lines.en: Push the button and it starts spinning them and heating them, making them hot so that they dry off.
lines.zh: 按下按鈕，它就會開始轉動、加熱，讓衣服變熱、變乾。

lines.en: That's why it's called a dryer because it dries your clothes.
lines.zh: 這就是它叫 dryer 的原因，因為它會把你的衣服弄乾。

lines.en: Unfortunately, guys, you can see that we have clothes hanging right here because the dryer at this new house, we just got this house not too long ago, our dryer does not work.
lines.zh: 可惜的是，大家可以看到我們衣服掛在這裡，因為這間新房子的烘衣機，我們才剛搬來沒多久，烘衣機壞了。

lines.en: We need to get a new dryer, but dryers are expensive, so we haven't bought one yet.
lines.zh: 我們需要買一台新的烘衣機，但烘衣機很貴，所以還沒買。

lines.en: So, right now, we hang our clothes and let them air dry.
lines.zh: 所以現在我們把衣服掛起來，讓它自然風乾。

lines.en: Soon, when we have a little bit of extra money, we'll get a new dryer so that camera wife can do the clothes and have it a little bit easier.
lines.zh: 等我們多存一點錢，就會買一台新的烘衣機，讓鏡頭老婆洗衣服可以輕鬆一點。

lines.en: So, guys, that's doing laundry.
lines.zh: 所以大家，這就是洗衣服。

lines.en: You wash your clothes in a washing machine if you're lucky enough to have one.
lines.zh: 如果你夠幸運有洗衣機，就用洗衣機洗衣服。

lines.en: If not, you wash them in a sink, in the bathtub, in a river, wherever you have to do it.
lines.zh: 如果沒有，就在水槽、浴缸、河裡，或任何你能洗的地方洗。

lines.en: And then you c you dry the clothes by putting them in a dryer if you're lucky enough to have one, or you hang them up and let them dry in the air.
lines.zh: 然後如果你夠幸運有烘衣機，就把衣服放進去烘乾，不然就把衣服掛起來自然風乾。

lines.en: It's better to let them dry outside because of the wind, but they will also dry if you just hang them up like this. Just takes longer.
lines.zh: 最好是拿到外面晾，因為有風，但就算像這樣掛著也會乾，只是比較久。

lines.en: So guys, that's doing the laundry. Okay, my friends.
lines.zh: 所以大家，這就是洗衣服。好，朋友們。

lines.en: So, those are the chores that I can think of inside of the house.
lines.zh: 這些就是我想得到的室內家事。

lines.en: Now, we're going to go outside and do a couple chores out there.
lines.zh: 現在我們要去外面做幾件家事。

lines.en: But the first one is a chore that starts in the house and ends outside. Taking out the garbage. Taking out the trash. Okay, trash and garbage.
lines.zh: 但第一件是從屋裡開始、在屋外結束的家事：倒垃圾。倒垃圾。好，trash 和 garbage。

lines.en: They mean the same thing.
lines.zh: 它們是一樣的意思。

lines.en: You'll hear both of those words when people are talking about the things that they throw away. Okay, garbage. Trash.
lines.zh: 大家在說要丟掉的東西時，這兩個字你都會聽到。好，garbage、trash。

lines.en: It goes in the garbage can or in some countries they might say trash bin.
lines.zh: 垃圾放在 garbage can，在某些國家可能會說 trash bin。

lines.en: All right, but here we call this a garbage can.
lines.zh: 好，但在這裡我們叫它 garbage can。

lines.en: And my garbage can is pretty full.
lines.zh: 我的垃圾桶已經滿了。

lines.en: So, it's time for me to take out the garbage. Take out the trash.
lines.zh: 所以我該去倒垃圾了。倒垃圾。

lines.en: So, you take the garbage bag, then we go take it outside.
lines.zh: 你把垃圾袋拿起來，然後我們把它拿到外面。

lines.en: Let's take out the trash. All right, guys. Taking out the garbage.
lines.zh: 我們去倒垃圾吧。好，大家，倒垃圾。

lines.en: This is the garbage can.
lines.zh: 這是垃圾桶。

lines.en: And it's common for there to be a garbage can for things like food, uh, the nasty garbage. Okay?
lines.zh: 通常會有一個垃圾桶裝食物之類的，呃，比較噁心的垃圾，好嗎？

lines.en: And a lot of people here have recycling bins, which is just for plastic, paper, cardboard, and glass.
lines.zh: 這裡很多人也有資源回收桶，只放塑膠、紙類、紙箱和玻璃。

lines.en: And that is the one that I recorded the intro in. So, don't worry.
lines.zh: 我開頭就是在那個桶子裡錄的，所以別擔心。

lines.en: That one is much cleaner.
lines.zh: 那個乾淨多了。

lines.en: And I set it up to where my camera doesn't touch anything nasty.
lines.zh: 而且我有擺好，讓我的相機不會碰到任何噁心的東西。

lines.en: So, just in case you guys were thinking, "Oo, this guy's gross."
lines.zh: 免得你們在想：「噁，這傢伙好髒。」

lines.en: I made sure to do that that opening shot as clean as I possibly could.
lines.zh: 我盡可能把開場那段拍得乾乾淨淨。

lines.en: So, we take the garbage out, we put in these garbage cans, and once every week, a garbage truck will come and pick it up.
lines.zh: 所以我們把垃圾拿出去，放進這些垃圾桶，每週一次垃圾車會來收。

lines.en: So, on that day, we have to take the cans out to the front of the house by the street, and we'll call that taking the garbage up or putting the cans out front for the garbage truck, something like that.
lines.zh: 所以那天我們要把垃圾桶推到屋子前面的街邊，我們會說 taking the garbage up，或把垃圾桶放到前面讓垃圾車收，大概是這樣。

lines.en: All right, guys. Here we are in my backyard.
lines.zh: 好，大家，現在我們在我的後院。

lines.en: Your backyard is the space outside of your house, the back of your house.
lines.zh: 後院就是你房子外面、房子後面的空間。

lines.en: I have a pretty good sized backyard and I love it because Connor can run around.
lines.zh: 我的後院還滿大的，我很喜歡，因為 Connor 可以在這裡跑來跑去。

lines.en: We could come out here and cook food on my grill.
lines.zh: 我們可以來這裡用我的烤肉架烤東西。

lines.en: It's a very nice space, but it's pretty big and there is a lot of grass.
lines.zh: 這是個很棒的空間，但它很大，有很多草。

lines.en: And that brings me to the last chore that we're going to talk about today. Cutting the grass. Okay.
lines.zh: 這就帶到今天要講的最後一件家事：割草。好。

lines.en: Now, there's different ways to say this.
lines.zh: 這有幾種不同的說法。

lines.en: Cutting the grass, mowing the lawn.
lines.zh: cutting the grass、mowing the lawn（割草）。

lines.en: That is my lawn mower. Okay.
lines.zh: 那是我的割草機。好。

lines.en: And it's green because it's electric.
lines.zh: 它是綠色的，因為它是電動的。

lines.en: I thought I would do good and buy an electric lawn mower and it would work great, but it doesn't really work that good, guys, because the battery dies very quickly.
lines.zh: 我以為買電動割草機是做好事，而且會很好用，但大家，它其實沒那麼好用，因為電池很快就沒電。

lines.en: So, having a big yard like this, an electric lawn mower is not very good.
lines.zh: 所以像這麼大的院子，電動割草機不太適合。

lines.en: But that's called a lawn mower.
lines.zh: 但那就叫做割草機。

lines.en: And you use a lawn mower to mow your lawn or cut your grass.
lines.zh: 你用割草機來 mow your lawn 或 cut your grass。

lines.en: So, I'm gonna start up my lawn mower and mow my lawn or cut my grass.
lines.zh: 所以我要啟動我的割草機去割草了。

lines.en: So, some people really enjoy mowing their lawn, taking nice care of their yard, and I enjoy that, too, to make my yard look nice, so my family has somewhere nice to be outside.
lines.zh: 有些人很喜歡割草、好好照顧院子，我也喜歡讓院子看起來漂亮，讓家人有個舒服的戶外空間。

lines.en: But it can be hot and it takes a long time with this big yard and especially when I have to keep on charging my battery on my lawn mower.
lines.zh: 但天氣可能很熱，院子又這麼大，要花很久時間，尤其我還得一直幫割草機的電池充電。

lines.en: So, I'm going to go ahead and charge I'm going to go ahead and cut my grass.
lines.zh: 所以我要去充……我要去割草了。

lines.en: But the one thing I do like about this this chore is that one, you can listen to something.
lines.zh: 但這件家事我喜歡的一點是，第一，你可以一邊聽東西。

lines.en: You can listen to a podcast or something on headphones while you do it, but you also get exercise.
lines.zh: 你可以一邊割草一邊用耳機聽 podcast 之類的，而且還能運動。

lines.en: And you can see I'm getting sun, which is very good for your body and your brain.
lines.zh: 你們也可以看到我在曬太陽，這對身體和大腦都很好。

lines.en: So guys, I'm going to cut my cut my grass real quick and then I have one last thing I want to share with you guys before we end this video.
lines.zh: 所以大家，我要快速割個草，然後在結束影片前，還有最後一件事想跟你們分享。

lines.en: See you in a minute. All right, guys.
lines.zh: 待會見。好，大家。

lines.en: It's kind of hot out there.
lines.zh: 外面有點熱。

lines.en: I just finished mowing my lawn or cutting my grass.
lines.zh: 我剛割完草了（mowing my lawn 或 cutting my grass）。

lines.en: Either of those means the same thing.
lines.zh: 這兩種說法意思一樣。

lines.en: To cut your grass or to mow your lawn.
lines.zh: to cut your grass 或 to mow your lawn。

lines.en: So my my lawn or my yard, which both pretty much means the same thing.
lines.zh: 所以我的 lawn 或我的 yard，兩個意思差不多。

lines.en: Your lawn is like the grass and the trees and stuff.
lines.zh: lawn 比較像是草地、樹之類的。

lines.en: Your yard is just the space out there outside of your house.
lines.zh: yard 就是你房子外面的空間。

lines.en: So my yard is looking pretty good now. I'm happy.
lines.zh: 我的院子現在看起來很不錯，我很開心。

lines.en: My family has a nice place to be outside.
lines.zh: 我的家人有個舒服的戶外空間。

lines.en: My son loves to go out there and run around.
lines.zh: 我兒子很愛去外面跑來跑去。

lines.en: So anyway, chores are done. I got some exercise. I got some sun.
lines.zh: 總之，家事做完了。我運動到了，也曬到太陽了。

lines.en: Now, I just want to share something with you guys because I'm excited about it. Let's see.
lines.zh: 現在我想跟大家分享一件事，因為我很興奮。我們來看看。

lines.en: As I'm recording this, it is August 21st, okay?
lines.zh: 我在錄這支影片的時候是 8 月 21 日，好嗎？

lines.en: And August 28th is my birthday.
lines.zh: 8 月 28 日是我的生日。

lines.en: I will be 34 years old.
lines.zh: 我要 34 歲了。

lines.en: And we're going to do something cool to celebrate my birthday.
lines.zh: 我們要做一件很酷的事來慶祝我的生日。

lines.en: We're going to go on a little trip, a little vacation, just a small one. 3 days.
lines.zh: 我們要去一趟小旅行、一個小假期，只是短短的三天。

lines.en: And we're not leaving the country, but we're going to see something beautiful, absolutely stunning that is here in the United States.
lines.zh: 我們不會出國，但我們要去看美國境內一個很美、美到令人驚嘆的地方。

lines.en: We are going to fly from Chicago, close to where I live.
lines.zh: 我們要從我家附近的芝加哥搭飛機。

lines.en: We're going to fly to Colorado, a state called Colorado.
lines.zh: 我們要飛到科羅拉多，一個叫科羅拉多的州。

lines.en: And there's something in Colorado that is one of the most beautiful places in all of the United States, one of the natural wonders of my country.
lines.zh: 科羅拉多有一個地方，是全美國最美的地方之一，是我國家的自然奇景之一。

lines.en: And I have never seen it. The Rocky Mountains, guys. I cannot wait.
lines.zh: 我從來沒看過。大家，就是洛磯山脈。我等不及了。

lines.en: We're going to see incredible lakes like this.
lines.zh: 我們會看到像這樣很棒的湖。

lines.en: This is a famous lake called Bear Lake.
lines.zh: 這是一個很有名的湖，叫熊湖（Bear Lake）。

lines.en: We're going to see the mountains.
lines.zh: 我們會去看山。

lines.en: We're going to rent a car and drive way up high into the mountains.
lines.zh: 我們要租一台車，開到山上很高的地方。

lines.en: And I have a lot of things I want to do there.
lines.zh: 我在那裡有很多想做的事。

lines.en: And I'm going to make some awesome videos.
lines.zh: 我也會拍一些很棒的影片。

lines.en: I'm thinking I might wait to make my questions and answer video for when we're there because that way it'll give you guys a few days to post good questions for me and I could record the questions and answers video with an incredible view behind me.
lines.zh: 我在想，也許我會等到了那裡再拍問答影片，這樣可以給你們幾天時間留一些好問題給我，我就可以在絕美的景色前錄問答影片。

lines.en: I might just do that because I want to make a bunch of content while we're there.
lines.zh: 我可能會這樣做，因為我想在那裡拍一堆內容。

lines.en: So, in a week it will be my birthday.
lines.zh: 所以再一個禮拜就是我的生日了。

lines.en: I'll be 20 or 24.
lines.zh: 我要 20 歲，還是 24 歲。

lines.en: I wish I'll be 34 years old and we'll be seeing something incredible.
lines.zh: 我希望啦。我要 34 歲了，而且我們會去看很棒的風景。

lines.en: Me, camera wife, and my son are going to go explore a beautiful part of my country.
lines.zh: 我、鏡頭老婆和我兒子要去探索我國家一個很美的地方。

lines.en: I'm going to show you guys what it looks like, too.
lines.zh: 我也會讓你們看看那裡長什麼樣子。

lines.en: Just wanted to share that with you because I'm excited and I wanted you guys to know we've got some awesome content coming up here on the channel.
lines.zh: 只是想跟你們分享，因為我很興奮，也想讓你們知道頻道接下來會有很棒的內容。

lines.en: So, my friends, I hope that you learned some useful vocabulary here about chores.
lines.zh: 所以朋友們，希望你們在這裡學到一些關於家事的實用單字。

lines.en: You know, it's it's not something super fun, but it's something that we do pretty much every day.
lines.zh: 你知道，這不是什麼超好玩的事，但我們幾乎每天都會做。

lines.en: So, if you're going to live your life in a new language, you've got to know these things.
lines.zh: 所以如果你要用一個新的語言過生活，就一定要知道這些。

lines.en: Thank you all for all your support, for leaving me your nice comments, for watching my videos, for spending your valuable time with me.
lines.zh: 謝謝大家的支持、留下好心的留言、看我的影片，還有把寶貴的時間花在我身上。

lines.en: I appreciate every single one of you.
lines.zh: 我感謝你們每一個人。

lines.en: See you in the next video, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友們，下支影片見。
